instrument_versions.export_limitation: The export row carries assigned_at_utc (assignments.created), not assignments.started. Without the optional --assignment-started sidecar, assigned_at is used as a lower bound of started: assigned_at >= reload proves the new wording, and answers with assigned_at < reload <= submitted are ambiguous, so ambiguous counts are upper bounds. With the sidecar the registered rule is applied exactly on started.
